考核与成绩构成

出勤Attendance15.0%4-15周考勤
汇报Presentation15.0%选3次最好成绩

期末考试Final Examination：口试 50.0%准确流利回答口试题

课程简介（中文）

当今世界，商务活动日益全球化，中国大学毕业生/求职者迫切需要提升职场英语能力、培养跨文化意识。本课程将通过商业案例来帮助学习者把握商务英语沟通技巧和专业词汇、学习商务基本知识、了解职场文化、运用个人和集体智慧分析和解决商务问题。

课程简介（英文）

In this age of business globalization, it is more critical than ever for Chinese college graduates/job applicants to improve English language abilities and develop intercultural competency. This course will employ business cases to help learners hone English communication skills in business settings,master specific vocabulary, learn business fundamentals, and get exposed to the business culture.Learners will leverage individual and team wisdom to devise solutions to business problems.

教学目标

学习者将会：

1.接触多个商业案例 （如Halston, Adore, Genki等）

2.用课上学习到的分析框架（如行业分析五力模型、风险分析及缓解、竞争战略、领导力、有效广告等）为上述案例设计解决方案

3.完成个人和小组课题 （会教授有效团队工作流程）

4.培养批判思考能力

5.提高职场英语交际能力，含表达个人意见、团队合作、陈述汇报

教学方式

1.教师讲授

2.视听材料

3.小组讨论及汇报

4.个人作业及反思

教学内容与进度安排

Week 1: Introduction

Week 2: Team process

Week 3: Group dynamics

Week 4: Business plan

Week 5: Industry analysis

Week 6: Risk analysis

Week 7: Risk mitigation

Week 8: Generic strategy

Week 9: Blue ocean strategy (1)

Week 10: Blue ocean strategy (2)

Week 11: Leadership

Week 12: Target market and advertising (1)

Week 13: Target market and advertising (2)

Week 14: Presentation skills

Week 15: Final exam
